purpose: Measure how distinguishable current versus empirical-adapter synthetic PRE races are from the already-held staged PRE candidate distribution, without promoting that third-party source to admitted real-world truth.

known_before_lock: A prior private prototype indicated the current uncalibrated Twin is trivially distinguishable from the staged PRE candidate source.
No discriminator result for digital_twin_empirical_pre_adapter_v1 has been computed before this lock.

The empirical adapter was built from preregistered aggregate constraints derived from the same staged PRE candidate source, so this diagnostic measures in-source envelope fit and cannot establish external real-world equivalence.

sample.real_candidate_subset: same standard-7 ordinary candidate subset used by KEIRIN_DT_EMPIRICAL_ENVELOPE_COMPACT_v1

race_level_feature_contract.real_rate_transform: starts = wins + seconds + thirds + outs; tactical count per start = count / starts when starts>0, else 0 with starts-zero race rows excluded only if a race-level feature cannot be formed
race_level_feature_contract.current_twin_tactical_semantics: existing synthetic B/S/nige/makuri/sashi/mark values used as generated rates
race_level_feature_contract.empirical_twin_tactical_semantics: empirical adapter B/S/nige/makuri/sashi/mark values used as generated rates

views.AUDIT_REALISM_VIEW: Use score on each source's presented PRE scale; this intentionally measures obvious unit/scale realism as part of audit-level resemblance.
views.SCALE_NEUTRAL_VIEW: Within each race replace rider score by race z-score before race-level score summaries; all non-score features unchanged. This tests remaining structural/tactical distinguishability without raw score units.

interpretation.desired_direction: Empirical-adapter AUC should be materially closer to 0.5 than current-Twin AUC in both views and both fixed classifiers.
interpretation.AUC_near_0_5_means: harder to distinguish from this staged candidate source under the locked race-level feature contract
